Remarks

This class stores and manages multiple IntersectSpaceRegister objects, each corresponding to a different collision object. Provides utilities for sorting, validation, and querying closest/furthest entries, registers, and collision points.

Validate(Vector2, out CollisionPointValidationResult)

Validates all registers and provides a detailed validation result.

public bool Validate(Vector2 referencePoint, out CollisionPointValidationResult validationResult)

Parameters

referencePoint Vector2

The point to check direction from.

validationResult CollisionPointValidationResult

The result containing combined, closest, furthest, and pointing-towards collision points.

Returns

bool

True if there are valid points remaining; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Removes:

  • Invalid IntersectionPoints
  • Points with normals facing in the same direction as the reference direction
  • Points with normals facing in the opposite direction as the reference point
